title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, a diet rich in iron and folate is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), iron and folate are the two most important nutrients during pregnancy. In this article, we will introduce three delicious and iron-rich, folate-rich recipes that can be cooked in 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two essential nutrients during pregnancy. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate helps prevent neural tube defects. To increase iron absorption, it is recommended to combine iron with vitamin C. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), vitamin C can increase iron absorption by up to 80%.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 100g white rice
* 50g mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper

Grill the chicken with vegetables, then serve with white rice and lemon. This recipe provides 10mg of iron and 100mcg of folate.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 100g white rice
* 50g mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper

Stir-fry the beef with vegetables, then serve with white rice and lemon. This recipe provides 15mg of iron and 150mcg of folate.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Red Bean and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g cooked red beans
* 100g white rice
* 50g mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans)
* 1 lemon
* Salt, pepper

Cook the red beans with vegetables, then serve with white rice and lemon. This recipe provides 10mg of iron and 100mcg of folate.

## Food Safety Notes
When pregnant, it is essential to avoid eating undercooked or raw foods. According to the National Health Service (NHS), pregnant women should avoid eating undercooked meat, raw eggs, and unpasteurized dairy products. Additionally, it is crucial to wash hands frequently and keep the kitchen clean.

## Conclusion
The three recipes above provide essential iron and folate for pregnant women. Remember to combine iron with vitamin C to increase iron absorption. Additionally, be mindful of food safety and wash hands frequently. For more information on pregnancy nutrition, visit our [website](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner).
